# Contract templates

- `broker-agreement.pdf`: 365 Yachts Broker Independent Contractor & Commission Agreement, blank (6 pages). Made from the signed Ben Fisher copy with every personal value, both signatures, the Acrobat Sign field and the audit page removed. The legal text is unchanged.
- `mutual-nda.pdf`: 365 Yachts Mutual Non-Disclosure & Non-Compete Agreement, blank (2 pages), unchanged.
- `*.fields.json`: where each value goes on each page (PDF points, top-left origin, 1-based pages). Checked with a test fill.
- `fonts/`: Carlito (SIL Open Font License, see CARLITO-LICENSE.txt), the font the agreement itself uses, for filling values so they match.

Never commit signed contracts here. Signed copies live only in the private storage bucket.
